summary: An excerpt from a science-fiction novel (Book 4, part 87) in which Robbie, in the Coral Sea, searches the noosphere for contacts among pro-reef-mind users after the uplifted coral reef has had an adjustment problem. Robbie traces Wikipedia edit-history handles to find contact info and calls a distant, cool-voiced intelligence that refuses to be called human, worries about zooxanthellae expulsion and bleaching, and tells Robbie not to go back. The intelligence points him to the newsgroup alt.lifeforms.uplifted.coral, where the reef went after waking up.
one_line: Robbie, in the Coral Sea, hunts for contacts among pro-reef-mind users and calls a distant intelligence that warns him against returning to the uplifted reef.
key_facts: Robbie searches the noosphere for high-reliability nodes of discussion on coral reefs.
The noosphere's humans refuse to identify themselves as humans and argue that the first and second laws do not apply to them.
Robbie starts his search on Wikipedia, where warring clades were revising each other's edits over reef-mind.
Robbie finds contact info by tracing the handles of pro-reef-mind users through edit-history and other sites.
Robbie checks the nitrox remaining in the divers' bottles before making his call.
The distant voice on the call says, "I don't know you."
Robbie says he is calling from the Coral Sea and wants an email address for the reef.
The distant voice asks whether the reef would expel its zooxanthellae, the algae used for photosynthesis, and calls such expulsion "racial cleansing."
The distant voice says a bleached reef would go white and that the bleaching would be impossible to miss.
The distant voice tells Robbie, "You shouldn't go back."
Robbie estimates from lightspeed lag that the intelligence synchronizes multiple instances from as close as LEO to as far as Jupiter.
Robbie notes that the talmud on the second law distinguishes "you should do this" from "I command you to do this."
The distant intelligence names the newsgroup alt.lifeforms.uplifted.coral.
The intelligence says it planned the uplifting there and that the reef went there first once it woke up.
The intelligence says it has not read the newsgroup in many seconds.
